verses.original: אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃ וַיַּ֥עַן
verses.transliteration: ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mar way·ya·‘an
verses.literal: Then Job . . . answered

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי רַבּ֑וֹת כְאֵ֣לֶּה עָמָ֣ל מְנַחֲמֵ֖י כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·tî rab·bō·wṯ ḵə·’êl·leh ‘ā·māl mə·na·ḥă·mê kul·lə·ḵem
verses.literal: I have heard many things like these miserable comforters are you all

verses.original: הֲקֵ֥ץ ר֑וּחַ א֥וֹ לְדִבְרֵי־ מַה־ יַּ֝מְרִֽיצְךָ֗ כִּ֣י תַעֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·qêṣ rū·aḥ ’ōw lə·ḏiḇ·rê- mah- yam·rî·ṣə·ḵā kî ṯa·‘ă·neh
verses.literal: Is there no end to your long-winded . . . speeches What provokes you to continue testifying

verses.original: אָנֹכִי֮ גַּ֤ם׀ אֲדַ֫בֵּ֥רָה כָּכֶ֪ם ל֤וּ־ נַפְשְׁכֶ֡ם יֵ֪שׁ נַפְשִׁ֗י תַּ֤חַת אַחְבִּ֣ירָה בְּמִלִּ֑ים עֲלֵיכֶ֣ם וְאָנִ֥יעָה רֹאשִֽׁי׃ עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם בְּמ֣וֹ
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî gam ’ă·ḏab·bê·rāh kā·ḵem lū- nap̄·šə·ḵem yêš nap̄·šî ta·ḥaṯ ’aḥ·bî·rāh bə·mil·lîm ‘ă·lê·ḵem wə·’ā·nî·‘āh rō·šî ‘ă·lê·ḵem bə·mōw
verses.literal: I could also speak like you if you were in my place I could heap up words against you and shake my head at you . . .

verses.original: אֲאַמִּצְכֶ֥ם בְּמוֹ־ פִ֑י וְנִ֖יד שְׂפָתַ֣י יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·’am·miṣ·ḵem bə·mōw- p̄î wə·nîḏ śə·p̄ā·ṯay yaḥ·śōḵ
verses.literal: But I would encourage you with my mouth and the consolation of my lips would bring relief

verses.original: אִֽם־ אֲ֭דַבְּרָה כְּאֵבִ֑י לֹא־ יֵחָשֵׂ֣ךְ וְ֝אַחְדְּלָ֗ה מַה־ מִנִּ֥י יַהֲלֹֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh kə·’ê·ḇî lō- yê·ḥā·śêḵ wə·’aḥ·də·lāh mah- min·nî ya·hă·lōḵ
verses.literal: Even if I speak my pain is not relieved and if I hold back how will it go away

verses.original: אַךְ־ עַתָּ֥ה הֶלְאָ֑נִי הֲ֝שִׁמּ֗וֹתָ כָּל־ עֲדָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ- ‘at·tāh hel·’ā·nî hă·šim·mō·w·ṯā kāl- ‘ă·ḏā·ṯî
verses.literal: Surely He has now exhausted me You have devastated all my family

verses.original: וַֽ֭תִּקְמְטֵנִי הָיָ֑ה לְעֵ֣ד כַ֝חֲשִׁ֗י וַיָּ֥קָם בִּ֥י יַעֲנֶֽה׃ בְּפָנַ֥י
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·mə·ṭê·nî hā·yāh lə·‘êḏ ḵa·ḥă·šî way·yā·qām bî ya·‘ă·neh bə·p̄ā·nay
verses.literal: You have bound me [and] it has become a witness my frailty rises up - and testifies against me

verses.original: אַפּ֤וֹ טָרַ֨ף׀ וַֽיִּשְׂטְמֵ֗נִי חָרַ֣ק בְּשִׁנָּ֑יו עָלַ֣י צָרִ֓י׀ יִלְט֖וֹשׁ לִֽי׃ עֵינָ֣יו
verses.transliteration: ’ap·pōw ṭā·rap̄ way·yiś·ṭə·mê·nî ḥā·raq bə·šin·nāw ‘ā·lay ṣā·rî yil·ṭō·wōš lî ‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: His anger has torn me and opposed me He gnashes His teeth at me My adversary pierces me with His eyes

verses.original: פָּעֲר֬וּ בְּפִיהֶ֗ם עָלַ֨י׀ הִכּ֣וּ לְחָיָ֑י בְּ֭חֶרְפָּה יִתְמַלָּאֽוּן׃ יַ֝֗חַד עָלַ֥י
verses.transliteration: pā·‘ă·rū bə·p̄î·hem ‘ā·lay hik·kū lə·ḥā·yāy bə·ḥer·pāh yiṯ·mal·lā·’ūn ya·ḥaḏ ‘ā·lay
verses.literal: They open their mouths against me and strike my cheeks with contempt they join together against me

verses.original: אֵ֭ל יַסְגִּירֵ֣נִי אֶ֣ל עֲוִ֑יל יִרְטֵֽנִי׃ וְעַל־ יְדֵ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: ’êl yas·gî·rê·nî ’el ‘ă·wîl yir·ṭê·nî wə·‘al- yə·ḏê rə·šā·‘îm
verses.literal: God has delivered me to unjust men He has thrown me to the clutches of the wicked

verses.original: הָיִ֨יתִי׀ שָׁ֘לֵ֤ו וַֽיְפַרְפְּרֵ֗נִי וְאָחַ֣ז בְּ֭עָרְפִּי וַֽיְפַצְפְּצֵ֑נִי וַיְקִימֵ֥נִי ל֝֗וֹ לְמַטָּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hā·yî·ṯî šā·lêw way·p̄ar·pə·rê·nî wə·’ā·ḥaz bə·‘ā·rə·pî way·p̄aṣ·pə·ṣê·nî way·qî·mê·nî lōw lə·maṭ·ṭā·rāh
verses.literal: I was at ease but He shattered me He seized me by the neck and crushed me He has set me up as His target

verses.original: רַבָּ֗יו יָ֘סֹ֤בּוּ עָלַ֨י׀ יְפַלַּ֣ח כִּ֭לְיוֹתַי וְלֹ֣א יַחְמ֑וֹל יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ מְרֵרָֽתִי׃ לָ֝אָ֗רֶץ
verses.transliteration: rab·bāw yā·sōb·bū ‘ā·lay yə·p̄al·laḥ kil·yō·w·ṯay wə·lō yaḥ·mō·wl yiš·pōḵ mə·rê·rā·ṯî lā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: His archers surround me . . . He pierces my kidneys without mercy and spills my gall on the ground

verses.original: יִפְרְצֵ֣נִי פֶ֭רֶץ עַל־ פְּנֵי־ פָ֑רֶץ יָרֻ֖ץ עָלַ֣י כְּגִבּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: yip̄·rə·ṣê·nî p̄e·reṣ ‘al- pə·nê- p̄ā·reṣ yā·ruṣ ‘ā·lay kə·ḡib·bō·wr
verses.literal: He breaks me with wound upon wound He rushes me like a mighty warrior

verses.original: תָּ֭פַרְתִּי שַׂ֣ק עֲלֵ֣י גִלְדִּ֑י וְעֹלַ֖לְתִּי קַרְנִֽי׃ בֶעָפָ֣ר
verses.transliteration: tā·p̄ar·tî śaq ‘ă·lê ḡil·dî wə·‘ō·lal·tî qar·nî ḇe·‘ā·p̄ār
verses.literal: I have sewn sackcloth over my skin I have buried my horn in the dust

verses.original: פָּנַ֣י חֳמַרְמְרָה מִנִּי־ בֶ֑כִי צַלְמָֽוֶת׃ וְעַ֖ל עַפְעַפַּ֣י
verses.transliteration: pā·nay ḥo·mar·mə·rå̄h min·nî- ḇe·ḵî ṣal·mā·weṯ wə·‘al ‘ap̄·‘ap·pay
verses.literal: My face is red with weeping and deep shadows ring my eyes

verses.original: עַ֭ל בְּכַפָּ֑י לֹא־ חָמָ֣ס וּֽתְפִלָּתִ֥י זַכָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al bə·ḵap·pāy lō- ḥā·mās ū·ṯə·p̄il·lā·ṯî zak·kāh
verses.literal: yet my hands are free of violence and my prayer is pure

verses.original: אֶ֭רֶץ אַל־ תְּכַסִּ֣י דָמִ֑י לְזַעֲקָתִֽי׃ וְֽאַל־ יְהִ֥י מָ֝ק֗וֹם
verses.transliteration: ’e·reṣ ’al- tə·ḵas·sî ḏā·mî lə·za·‘ă·qā·ṯî wə·’al- yə·hî mā·qō·wm
verses.literal: O earth do not cover my blood may my cry for help never be laid to rest

verses.original: גַּם־ עַ֭תָּה הִנֵּה־ עֵדִ֑י בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְ֝שָׂהֲדִ֗י בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ‘at·tāh hin·nêh- ‘ê·ḏî ḇaš·šā·ma·yim wə·śā·hă·ḏî bam·mə·rō·w·mîm
verses.literal: Even now . . . my witness is in heaven and my advocate is on high

verses.original: רֵעָ֑י מְלִיצַ֥י עֵינִֽי׃ דָּלְפָ֥ה אֶל־ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ
verses.transliteration: rê·‘āy mə·lî·ṣay ‘ê·nî dā·lə·p̄āh ’el- ’ĕ·lō·w·ha
verses.literal: My friends are my scoffers as my eyes pour out [tears] to God

verses.original: לְגֶ֣בֶר וְיוֹכַ֣ח עִם־ אֱל֑וֹהַּ וּֽבֶן־ אָדָ֥ם לְרֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḡe·ḇer wə·yō·w·ḵaḥ ‘im- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ū·ḇen- ’ā·ḏām lə·rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: Oh, that a man might plead with God as [he] [pleads] . . . with his neighbor

verses.original: כִּֽי־ מִסְפָּ֣ר שְׁנ֣וֹת יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ אֶהֱלֹֽךְ׃ וְאֹ֖רַח לֹא־ אָשׁ֣וּב
verses.transliteration: kî- mis·pār šə·nō·wṯ ye·’ĕ·ṯā·yū ’e·hĕ·lōḵ wə·’ō·raḥ lō- ’ā·šūḇ
verses.literal: For when only a few years are past I will go the way of no return
